name: Stony Grasp
body:
School transmutation [earth]; Level bloodrager 3, magus 3, shaman 3, sorcerer/wizard 3, witch 3

Components V, S, M (a fist-sized stone)

Effect animated stone hand

This spell functions like earthen grasp, except the hand is made of stone. The hand has an AC of 18, a hardness of 8, and 4 hit points per caster level.
